notes.content:
Fixed the enemy material thing referenced in previous post

notes.title: Hotfix with slight alterations
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs that concerned how much AI healed.
 Made laser bullets reflectable.
 Fixed some summons as well.
 Adjusted resistances of some AI too.
 Elites should now always spawn with their respective colour changes.
 Added an option in gameplay to aim or not aim with mouse for keyboard&mouse players

notes.title: Price Slash Update
notes.content:
QOL: Various little changes here and there 
Economy: Interest changed, money and items scale in price as the game progresses
Enemies: Entirely new AI with different behaviours
Items: A new leap item
Balance: Hero and AI numbers readjuted to fit with new overhaul

notes.title: Minor Changes
notes.content:
UI:
- Added comprehensive descriptions in the character select UI
- Once reaching Max shop tier, it properly displays MAX instead of being stuck at the previous value
New Features:
- Added a difficulty select option before you launch into the main game
- Added an additional shop tier
Music:
- Removed some old tracks 
- Added one new track

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes:
- Mage's beam now scales properly with ability haste instead of inversely
- Mage's SHIFT has had its CD doubled
- Mage's Primary has been buffed

notes.title: Bug hotfix
notes.content:
Bugs:
- Fixed bug where attack indicators would be less than attack collider
- Fixed bug where some effect-trigger items would cause crashes
- Fixed bug where a knockback would cause other issues
- FIxed bug where knocked-up enemy would wake up in air from sleep

notes.title: Early October Update
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Slammer has been buffed
- Robo Slammer has been buffed
- Gruntbot has been buffed
- Krample mech boss has been buffed
- No more following indicator, replaced with big AOE zones instead
- Mage has been buffed
- All melee agents have had their end window increased (debuff)
- Amagus's blink is now on the CTRL instead of M2 and beam is on M2
Bug Fixing:
- Fixed a bug where the barrier bar would persist after having your barrier broken
QOL:
- Can now see damage type of each ability in shop
- Attack Indicators are now in, makes gameplay better

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: - Fixed Captains special from doing crazy damage

notes.title: Update notes for September Update
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Air juggling is in, some abilities can knock light enemies airborne.
- Gruntbot has been buffed
- Line Laser Enemy now fires more slowly, giving player time to react
- Krample mech boss has been buffed
Bug Fixing:
- Fixed a bug where projectiles would stand still instead of moving
QOL:
- An option to view your stats is in the shop now
- Enemies with shields now have a bar to indicate the bar's health
- Critical hits now stand out more 
- Screen shake has been adjusted to not cause nause anymore
- Can now cancel basic attacks more fluidly

notes.title: - First Content Update with Fixes
notes.content:
QoL Additions
- Added screen shake slider to options
Content
- Added 7 new items
- Replaced Radial Wave Spawning Enemy with a Mage Enemy
- GruntBots now also have a ranged attack
- Added some new music tracks
Bug Fixes
- Fixed some minor bugs to do with projectiles
Changes
- Marmo's capacitor is now an epic
- Trigger Module is now a legendary
- Some enemies now rotate slower the closer you are to them
- Charger Attack lasts less
